- **Location:** `/home/gohan/runners/security-agent-2/_work/security-agent/security-agent/target_workspace/beacon-chain/core/peerdas/p2p_interface.go:155-157`

- `expectedTopic`: String (UNTRUSTED + "/") → Used in weak substring matching
